text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! When it comes to our generation, my eyes always went to Cesario and the like, but...
Daring Heart really is incredible after all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She ran through that Triple Tiara...
Of course she's tough as nails...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations, Daring Heart!"
"You're the Queeeeeeennnn!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, aren't they?
...It looks like they've been polished up nicely!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: But... I can keep going...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
――Listen up!
Starting today, you shall call me the Queen of Hearts!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Queen of Hearts~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Thanks!
Having achieved a brilliant victory in the race she had dreamed of, Daring Heart was in high spirits upon her return.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? That's strange.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Won't you call me that?
"Queen of Hearts," I mean.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The crowd responded enthusiastically, you know?
As my Trainer, you can't afford
to fall behind, can you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Come on, you've got to manage your Umamusume's motivation! Now, out with it. Well~?

...I feel like she's always teasing me like this.
Thinking that made me want to get some payback.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Thank you, my lord.♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Now then! Did that set the stage for me to fulfill my promise to Craft, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Still, there's still time...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. After running today, it hit me—
I think... I perform better the more actual races I get under my belt.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Races are another type of extreme condition...
They let you train your mind to the utmost limit, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
To make the showdown with her the absolute best!
Are there any good races?

Until now, Daring Heart has preferred
to run on the Tiara route.
If that's the case, taking that trend into account—
choice_data_list: How about the GⅡ Fuchu Umamusume Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Another 1800m race!
It's early in October, so it's a perfect tune-up
before the Mile Championship...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Okay, our next target race is
the 'Fuchu Umamusume Stakes'…… We'll sharpen our focus there—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
As an unshakable queen,
let us welcome Craft!

—The next day. Before heading back to summer camp,
we decided to do a little sightseeing in Sapporo
at Daring Heart's request.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, fruit!
Could this work, I wonder!?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Here's a souvenir for you, Tact!
You got the lucky charm, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering what to give as thanks.
Wouldn't some fresh Hokkaido produce be nice?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Aaah, I forgot to ask what she likes!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Ahaha.
That's right, I have the wonders of modern technology on my side."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like I spent too much time living in the wild.
I might start preferring the mountains before long.
choice_data_list: That'll make it harder to enter races, huh.
That'll make it harder to enter races, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That wouldn't do!
That would be a problem. The race comes first!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "I love being out in nature, but nothing's more fun than racing!"

I can feel Daring Heart's sense of fulfillment.
Right now, she is thoroughly enjoying the youth
that is her racing life to the absolute fullest.

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Student A
text_block_list.text:
âCome on, hurry up!
You want to learn my new technique, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Student B
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ma'am!
—'Cause I wanna be just like you, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"‘...I want to run with strong feelings too.
—Just like Ms. Heart.’"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should look for something nature-themed
as a souvenir for Tact after all?
Like a photo of flowers.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Is there anywhere in Sapporo where I can do some survival training?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Souvenirs for Craft and the others!
Could you help me find a good mountain!?
Right now!
choice_data_list: Shouldn't that part just be normal...?
Shouldn't that part just be normal...?

text_block_list.text:
"Heading into the Fuchu Umamusume Stakes,
Daring Heart once again returns to those precious days of youth..."
